### Idols in Our Hearts
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/idols-in-our-hearts-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-february-24-2016.html
Passage: Ezekiel 14:3
Points:
- The first two commandments emphasize that nothing may take God's place.
- An idol is anything or anyone given priority over the Lord.
- Even good things, such as careers, relationships, or possessions, can become idols.
- Harboring idols in our hearts causes God to refuse to hear our prayers.
- Believers must keep their devotion pure so their communion with God is unhindered.

### American Idle
Author: Karen Ehman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-may-27-2008-11576212.html
Passage: Ezekiel 14:3
Points:
- While physical idols are rare today, believers still harbor secret idols of the heart.
- Anything placed before God, including career, entertainment, or food, functions as an idol.
- Procrastination and remaining passive allow hidden idols to cause ongoing harm.
- Tearing down inward idols requires intentional action through God's strength and grace.
- Breaking these idols restores the Lord alone to the throne of one's life.
